title: Spatiotemporal Landslide Runout Reconstruction from Sparse Observations with LAPIS-SHRED
abstract: arXiv:2611.27132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing the spatiotemporal evolution of landslide runout from limited observations is a central challenge in geohazard assessment: transient flow dynamics are rarely observed directly, and available data are often confined to post-event deposits or brief monitoring windows. We apply LAPIS-SHRED (LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequence using SHallow REcurrent Decoders) to reconstruct runout events near Mount St. Helens, USA. Trained on physics-based simulation ensembles, the framework supports both backward reconstruction from single frame and forward prediction from short initial window across different runout regimes. Using 32 sensor observations from a single timepoint, LAPIS-SHRED recovers complete runout trajectories with NRMSE below 5.8%, robust across varying observational and training conditions. Validation against observed deposits yields spatial correlation of r = 0.843 against the calibrated simulator's r = 0.8

translated_title: 基于LAPIS-SHRED的稀疏观测滑坡运动时空重建
translated_abstract: 从有限的观测数据中重建滑坡运动过程的时空演化是地质灾害评估中的核心挑战：瞬态流动动力学很少能被直接观测到，且可用数据通常仅限于事件后的沉积物或短暂的监测窗口。我们将LAPIS-SHRED（基于浅层循环解码器的短时序潜相位推断方法）应用于美国圣海伦斯火山附近的滑坡运动事件重建。该框架在基于物理的模拟集合上训练，支持从单帧进行反向重建以及从短初始窗口进行前向预测，并可适用于不同的滑坡运动状态。仅使用单一时间点的32个传感器观测数据，LAPIS-SHRED即可恢复完整的滑坡运动轨迹，NRMSE低于5.8%，且在不同的观测和训练条件下均保持稳健。与实际观测沉积物的对比验证显示，其空间相关性达r = 0.843，高于校准后的模拟器的r = 0.8
tldr: 提出LAPIS-SHRED框架，仅凭单一时间点的32个稀疏传感器观测即可重建完整的滑坡运动时空演化轨迹（NRMSE低于5.8%），且与实际沉积物的空间相关性（0.843）超过了校准物理模拟器的表现。
en_tdlr: LAPIS-SHRED reconstructs complete spatiotemporal landslide runout trajectories from sparse single-timepoint sensor observations (NRMSE below 5.8%), achieving higher spatial correlation with observed deposits (r = 0.843) than a calibrated physics-based simulator, while supporting both backward reconstruction and forward prediction.
